fingerprint.generated_after_all_repetitions: final repetition endpoint only; repetitions do not alter the scientific endpoint because every horizon restarts from the frozen initial state

O0 and O2 fingerprint records are byte-identical
all routes, state, mass and transfer gates pass

no timing intrinsic or external timing endpoint is used
